description: This is a main source file for a FastAPI backend API for personal notes management. It sets up routes for user registration, login, profile retrieval, and CRUD operations for notes, utilizing dependencies, middleware, and database models.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: FastAPI application instance initialized with API metadata and tags.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model class imported from src.models.user.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Authentication token schema imported from src.schemas.auth.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a user, imported from src.schemas.user.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema for exposing user data, imported from src.schemas.user.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a note, imported from src.schemas.note.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating a note, imported from src.schemas.note.

classes.name: NoteOut
classes.description: Schema for exposing note data, imported from src.schemas.note.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple JSON message.

methods.name: register_user(payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, avoiding duplicate usernames.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate and generate JWT token for a user.

methods.name: read_users_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current authenticated user's data.

methods.name: api_create_note( payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Create a new note associated with the current user.

methods.name: api_list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: List all notes owned by the current user.

methods.name: api_get_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieve a specific note if owned by the current user.

methods.name: api_update_note( note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Update title and/or content of a note owned by the user.

methods.name: api_delete_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Delete a note owned by the current user.

ctags.name: api_create_note
ctags.signature: ( payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: api_delete_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: api_get_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: api_list_notes
ctags.signature: ( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: api_update_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.pattern: /^def login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
